svg.title: The characterization course
svg.desc: Top-down plan of the campaign in the mocap frame: an 8 by 6 meter geofence with a 0.4 meter margin, the mapping drive's lanes 1 meter apart, the 6 by 3.6 meter figure-8 the sentry laps at 0.8 m/s, and four 10-minute hold spots, each facing a different way.
